name: print-social-yellow-brand-activation-stage-with-rounded-frames
title: Yellow product-launch stage with a rounded LED frame, terraced platforms and giant logo disc
whatItIs: A render of a stage set in yellow: a big rounded frame around an LED wall showing floating orange capsules, three pots on stepped teal and yellow platforms, a glowing logo disc in front and a fruit-slice cube at the right.
whatItMeans: Sunny and fresh; the fruit-yellow world makes a beauty product feel joyous.
techniques: Wrap a screen in a chunky rounded frame.
Use a round glowing logo as a stage centre.
Keep the set in brand yellow with teal accents.

vocabulary.definition: A soft-cornered frame around a screen.
A set built in the brand colours.
A circular podium carrying a logo.
